name: 60-200km Audax - Jet Squad Base Gamechanger
description:
An opportunity you don’t want to miss!

Audax is our friendly, long-distance endurance group ride designed to build a strong aerobic base for the upcoming season. This is where we develop metabolic efficiency, improve our ability to use fat as fuel, and build stronger, more resilient mitochondria.

We ride in a tight, efficient group to maximize speed and minimize energy expenditure. We support each other, work together, and help bring riders back into the group when they get dropped.

Our routes are mainly flat, with a few short kickers to keep things interesting and the intensity up.

Flyers are NOT welcome! If you decide to attack, surge, or ride off the front, don’t expect the group to chase you. You will be skipped by the leaders. This is endurance training, not a race.

STYLE

The ride is led by The Jet (coach) or a designated deputy, depending on the current training schedule.

You’ll ride alongside athletes from The Jet Squad, including professional athletes and strong Kona-level age-group triathletes building their aerobic base for the upcoming season.

Distances will increase throughout each training block according to the squad’s training plans. Riders may leave the group at different points to match their individual schedules.

Expect structure, teamwork, discipline, and plenty of kilometers added to your books.

WHO CAN JOIN?

Everyone who wants to go beyond standard winter training and build a strong foundation for the next season.

Triathletes, cyclists, hand cyclists, and other endurance enthusiasts are all welcome.

Be realistic about your current fitness level: these rides are demanding, and you may need to build up gradually over several sessions to stay with the group all the way to the finish.

Come ready to work. Leave stronger.

WHEN

Usually Saturday and Sunday early mornings (CET).

Check the event announcement for the latest schedules, routes, distances and details.

PACING

Front group targets:

Flat roads: 2.8–3.2 W/kg
Climbs: 3.0–4.8 W/kg
The coach may adjust these targets depending on the purpose of the session and the current training block.

Slower groups will naturally form behind the front group. Ride at a pace that allows you to train effectively and sustainably.

THE TARGET: LIGHTSPEED, NOT CHAOS!

The mission is simple: fast, steady, and controlled from start to finish.

No over pacing in the first half.
No unnecessary surges.
No power drop-off in the final kilometers.
No ego-driven attacks.
We ride as a group, maintain a consistent rhythm, and work together to keep the speed high.

Save your matches. You’ll need them later.

You will suffer. Just wait for it.

NUTRITION & BREAKS

Preparation starts well before the ride.

You are responsible for your own nutrition and hydration. Plan ahead and bring enough fuel to cover the full distance.

Hydration: As a starting point, plan for at least 1 liter of fluid per hour, adjusted to your sweat rate, indoor conditions, and individual needs. Include electrolytes.
Carbohydrates: Bring enough carbs to fuel the session according to its intensity, duration, and your nutrition strategy.
Backup supplies: Carry an additional bottle and spare nutrition, such as bananas, energy bars, or gels.
Metabolic training: Some sessions may provide an opportunity to practice riding with lower carbohydrate availability, but this must be planned and appropriate to the session. Don’t confuse under fueling with effective training.
Fuel smart. Ride strong. Finish strong.

THE GOAL

Cover the planned distance as quickly as possible while maintaining a steady, sustainable effort throughout the entire ride.

We are building the engine for next season: aerobic endurance, metabolic efficiency, pacing discipline, and group-riding skills.

The goal isn’t to win the first 50 km. It’s to finish the full distance strong.

AUDAX – THE MYTH

Audax is a long-distance cycling discipline in which participants aim to complete a defined route within a specified time limit. Traditionally, it emphasizes endurance, self-sufficiency, and completion rather than racing against other riders.

The roots of Audax go back to Italian endurance events in the late nineteenth century, with formal rules subsequently developed in France.

Learn more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audax

ENJOY THE RIDE. EMBRACE THE DISTANCE. BUILD THE ENGINE.

THE JET SQUAD

name: Fishalicious does new routes! 🦈
description:
Join the Fishalicious banded ride for fun that's off the scale - NEW route special! 

Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the "rubber-band" activated, which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast, and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.

The ride speed may be slightly less than other group rides due to the rubber band effect, but that's a small price to pay to allow riders of all levels to remain together throughout the ride. We are all about teamwork, working together as a group, and we look forward to riding with you!

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Loopin Lava | Week 1
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

description:
Welcome to the L’Equipe Provence Badge Hunter Series! Our dedicated Team of Leaders and Sweepers created the concept of Zwift Badge Hunting and continue to refine, expand and perfect the art of the Hunt. Together, we share two goals: stacking badges and having fun! Whether this is your first time with us or you just want to tap into the contagious enthusiasm from a community of like-minded Zwifters, you’re in the right place. As a bonus, finish the Hunt and unlock the L’Equipe Provence Team Kit!

Teamwork makes the dreamwork! Stick together, use the group draft and encourage each other in the chat to get through these challenging rides. Group C will be between 2.5-3.2 w/kg and Group D will be between 2.0-2.5 wkg.

Visit our Team Shop:
https://jakroo.com/store-front?storeId=BJ2aA7Ay5#

Join our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/leqpprovencezwift/

Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lequipeprovence/

Chat on our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/a8TCFft

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: LGBTQz Ride with Pride
description:
We invite everyone to join LGBTQ Zwifters and friends as we Ride with Pride all
year round. Our Sunday social ride is all about togetherness and most rides will use the rubber band so we can be one big, joyful bunch where everyone belongs. No surges, no stress, no getting left behind.  Our rides are inclusive and chat may involve LGBTQIA+ topics so please come with an open heart and open mind. 


You can check whether the rubber band will be in use by clicking the ‘Toggle Event Details’ link at the end of the event description on zwift.com.

Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.

If you want to learn more about our Club, please visit: https://lgbtq-zwifters.com/

name: WELCOME TO THE BRAUNSTEIN CYCLING CLUB DANISH GROUP RIDE
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: Watts More To the Top!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration! 

At Sunday morning we go To the top! A rideleader will guide you through the hills and mountains that Zwift has to offer. On the flats we will ride about 2.5 w/kg and on the climbs around 3.0 w/kg reflecting a C-category ride. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob. During the season we build up the elevation meters. 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September the rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.  
 
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share 

 Join Watts More on Zwift  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/d6afeaa7-e754-478a-b68d-2a794648fa02/home

name: SZR Groupworkouts by Aktivitus
description:
These WOs are designed to give you improved aerobic development and increased aerobic threshold (LT1) -endurance - in a 2h workout. To get most out of this session, make sure your FTP is correct set. If you are aerobic underdeveloped for cycling you may need to decrease your FTP-settings.

The workout is 120min and starts with a 15min warmup. First main block is 3x15min at a controlled threshold/Sweet spot (90% of FTP) on lower cadences to wear us down and to get a time effective local aerobic development and cycling strength (endurance).

The second block contains 20x30/60sek intervals. 30sec at 150% of FTP with a 1min active rest. This is highly anaerobic which gives us an improved lactic tolerance and an increased anaerobic stanima. However, in a worn-out state these intervals will also stress your aerobic development. That means you oxygen transport into your working muscles will get better. Your endurance will thereby increase.

This WO is designed Johan Hasselmark at Aktivitus (www.aktivitus.se). Aktivitus runs Swedens leading test and coaching operations for endurance sports.
Johan Hasselmark is an international level adventure racer and extreme triathlete with several wins, 30 years of competative experince in endurance sports and 8 years of coaching and physiological testing.

name: ZZRC Wacky Chase
description:
Welcome to ZZRC’s Wacky Chase!

Get ready to saddle up for an unforgettable adventure that combines pace, fun, and a dash of friendly competition! Our group rides are open to all riders, and we’ve constructed a delightful two paced category to ensure everyone can enjoy a safe and top-notch experience on two wheels.

Here’s the game plan: we’ve divided our crew into two spirited teams. Team B will zoom at a snappy 3.2-3.8 pace, Team C will enjoy a smooth cruise at 2.4-2.8. We’re throwing in a twist of excitement with a hot chase. Team C takes off first from the pen, followed swiftly by Team B.

This isn’t just another group ride; it’s your ticket to banter, camaraderie, and a good ol’ time! Our leaders will guide you, sharing pacing tips and tricks along the way. Remember, teamwork makes the dream work, so use that draft to your advantage as you barrel through the ride together!

A couple of quick housekeeping notes: we’re keeping the atmosphere all-inclusive and relaxed, with a focus on enjoyment rather than perfection. Sweeps and Ride Buddies will be off-duty this time, so if you find yourself lagging behind, feel free to continue at your own pace or buddy up with fellow riders nearby.

And hey, we’ve got a little rule: leave the TT Bikes at home! They don’t draft well and might make you puff and pant a bit more than you want. Mountain bikes? They’re welcome too, just be prepared to push a little harder than the folks on road bikes. No worries if you hit a snag; our 30-minute late join feature will let you teleport back to the main group with the magical YELLOW BEACON!

We’re all about chatting and having fun while we ride, so don’t miss out on our dedicated Discord channel! Join us, choose your pace, and get ready to share the laughs as we roll.

**Top Tips for Wacky Chase Success:**

1. Stick close to your ride leader; don’t let that gap turn into a canyon!

2. Avoid the fence—we want you in one piece, not fried!

3. Most importantly… HAVE FUN! This is all about the adventure.

Don’t forget to connect with us on our ZZRC Facebook page and join the club on the companion app for all the latest gossip and rides!

So get your cycling gear on, bring your best vibes, and let’s hit the Zwift Roads together!

Discord Channel

https://discord.com/channels/1009379476041383946/1009388181269004289

name: Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride
description:
Sortie dominicale Foudre : Foudre Sunday Coffee Ride

INTRO
La Team Foudre vous propose de venir évacuer les toxines de Mirabelle de la vieille, de passer un moment ensemble pour peaufiner votre endurance, et s'amuser lors des sprints pour les plus valeureux.
Lors de cette sortie plus longue, nous arpenterons des parcours variés et plus longs. Il s’agit d’une sortie de groupe conviviale et non d’une course, n’hésitez pas à venir nous rejoindre sur le canal vocal général sur le Discord.

name: Flanders Endurance Race
description:
Prepare your racing and climbing skills for the Flanders Endurance Race League.
This league are open races (held on Sunday) build on stamina. Races will be longer dan 2 hours.
Please note the race is from the gun, including any event 'warm-up' on the lap counter. Categories will all start together.

RACE RULES

No powerups.
No TT bikes.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for "all" categories.
Power Meter and Smart Trainer winners take category win.
zPower riders will not be included in zwiftpower results

Riders must opt-in to ZwiftPower for official results via their Zwift profile settings @ https://my.zwift.com/profile/connectionsOpens a new window
Riders must register an account @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window and agree to the T&C's to be included in official results.
Riders going over 5w/kg at 95% of 20 minute power will be removed from results.
Riders going over 6w/kg for 5 minute power will be removed from results.
Official results located @ www.zwiftpower.comOpens a new window

It is essential that all participants are honest and select the correct pen/category below which correlates to their current/potential FTP. (Please use your FTP divided by your weight in kg to select the correct category below.) Riders that have at least 3 ZP results (in their race history) on a higher FTP category level than the chosen one will be DQ'd ! If you're in doubt, please contact the organizer for more information.

NOTE : if you have a ZP cat tag lower than your W/kg FTP due to low body weight choose your FTP cat ! Example : Rider with an FTP of 4.5 W/kg but a B tag on ZP because of <250W will race A and not B !

name: Giant Camden Tron Hunters – get closer to the Tron
description:
The ultimate Zwift reward, the Zwift Concept Bike (aka Tron) takes a lot of effort to acquire; you have to climb 50,000mts of elevation to get your hands on this prize. Team Giant Camden organizes weekly rides around the hilliest routes to rack up elevation and give you a good endurance ride, so this is the perfect opportunity if you’re hunting for the Tron or some of the toughest route badges on Zwift and want some company.

**This is not a race** but some riders will go full steam, the majority of us will be taking a steady ride and chat in game. Find riders around your ability and share the work.

**Don’t forget to have the Everest Challenge selected before joining: https://zwiftinsider.com/tron-bike/ **

name: WKG PROGRESSION RIDERS
description:
IMPORTANT - READ BELOW:
A fully original Zwift format built around 8 stages per season.
Social ride with a competitive edge.
⸻
PR LIVES ON ProgressionRiders.Club — JOIN THE GROUP
All chat and questions live here:

Ride voice channel:
• https://discord.gg/ZhVdwkJH8w

THE JERSEY GAME
PR is about moments, not only raw watts.
* Green – sprints
* Red – climbs
* Yellow – all-rounder points

Miss the moment — miss the jersey.
⸻
SEASON FORMAT
Each season = 8 stages with leaderboards
Every stage favors a different rider type:
Sprinteur · Rouleur · Puncheur · Grimpeur

RIDE FORMAT (FAST)
(The Development Team)
Read the objectives on Discord or in the rulebook

• B & C chases for the stage multiplier
• After the catch, B & C rides together
• Only advertised segments are contested
⸻
WATCH THE STAGE BRIEF
https://progressionriders.club/

Takes 1 minute. You will want an overview.

Join the WKG Club on:
• https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1DMqBvjGV1/?mibextid=wwXIfr
⸻
You don’t just ride PR.
You play it.

name: Compass Community Sunday Quiz Ride
description:
Looking to build endurance without watching the clock? This social group ride is the perfect way to make 90 minutes fly by.

We roll through two 30-minute intervals, each with a 30-second push at the start and end—just enough to add some spice without breaking the flow. But the real magic? The random quiz of the day. It’s the perfect excuse for great chat, friendly banter, and a few unexpected laughs while we pedal. Before you know it, you’re deep into the ride, your legs are ticking over, and the session is nearly done.

⚠️ Important note
• This is a social group ride, not a coached training session.
• Everyone rides at their own pace and you join at your own risk. Please ride within your personal limits and listen to your body.
• The leader and club are volunteers and accept no responsibility for injury, illness, or equipment issues arising from participation.

Ride. Quiz. Have fun. See you on the virtual road!

name: La Cyclo MedioFondo Foudre - Age & Women categories⚡️!
description:
CATEGORIES
A: < 39 ans
B: 40-49 ans
C: 50-59 ans
D: > 60 ans
E: Féminine

FRANCAIS

INTRO :
A l’image des Cyclosportives, nous vous proposons de participer tous les Dimanche matin à une Cyclo sur Zwift, d’une durée d’environ 2h et avec ranking.
Viens participer pour viser la performance, tenter de te dépasser ou simplement pour te balader en groupe avec les amis et coureurs de même niveau.
Lors de ces évènements, nous arpenterons des parcours divers et variés, régulièrement vallonnés.
Le départ sera groupé entre toutes les catégories, des groupes de niveau se créeront lors des différentes difficultés du parcours.
Pas de bonus FAL/FTS, les Power-Ups sont et le steering sont désactivé.

RÈGLES :
L'inscription sur Zwiftpower.com est nécessaire pour apparaître au classement de la manche et au classement général.
Les zPower (Home Trainer sans capteur de puissance) seront supprimés des résultats.
Les vélos de contre la montre ne sont pas autorisés, sauf indication contraire.
Les moniteurs de fréquence cardiaque sont obligatoires pour toutes les catégories.
Le double enregistrement de capture de puissance est obligatoire pour les meilleures performances, dans toutes les catégories*.
*Toutefois, s’il ne vous est pas possible de fournir une double analyse (ex : pas de capteur de puissance externe), cela ne sera pas forcément signe de disqualification. Une analyse sera effectuée par un organisateur concernant votre puissance, cardio et données de performances IRL accessible sur votre compte Strava, afin de vous déclasser ou non.


ENGLISH

INTRO:
We invite you to participate every Sunday morning in a 2h race, with ranking, such as IRL MedioFondos.
Come and participate to aim for performance, try to surpass yourself or simply to ride in a group with friends and eCyclists of the same level.
During these races, we will ride various and varied courses, most of the time hilly roads.
All the racers will start together, groups of level will probably be created during the different difficulties of the course.
No FAL/FTS bonus, Power-Up and steering are disabled.

RULES:
Registration on Zwiftpower.com is required to be ranked.
zPower (Smart Trainer without power meter) will be removed from the results.
Time trial bikes are not allowed unless otherwise specified.
Heart rate monitors are mandatory for all categories.
Dual (power) record is mandatory for the top performances. All categories*.
*However, if it is not possible for you to provide a double analysis (e.g. no external power meter), this will not necessarily be a sign of disqualification. Indeed, an analysis will be made by the organizers regarding your power, heart rate, and IRL performances accessible on Strava account, to keep you or not in the results.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (BEAT Cycling Club)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by BEAT Cycling Club (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/35cca0e7-d713-46d4-8fa7-7c8dd012d8c7).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.


#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #beat

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group C.

Although this is not really a race, it will in true Zwift tradition maybe get a bit spicy. This ride is not always led by members or our club, so we encourage anyone to join and test each other out with the average power numbers set for the group.

When in place a leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. Please chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post.

Please use our “Sunday Club Ride” Discord voice channel here:  https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849513313042463

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride. Often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up. We ride in various group. This is group D.

It’s a group ride so it’s not a race.  All abilities are welcome, but we’ll be tootling along at between 1.5 to 2.2. That’s where the banners will be but if you fancy shooting ahead on the day you are very welcome. You might miss the craic, but you won’t get removed. We might do some wee tests or sprints or little races to the lamppost if we/you feel like it. If you’re way ahead by then you might miss something fun.

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back. We will chat via messaging, but we have a discord channel for you to use for the banter if you want. If for some reason you can’t make the start time, late joining is available up to 30mins post.

Please use our “Sunday Club Ride” Discord voice channel here: https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329850433962770657

eventSubgroups.name: Zwift Riders Scotland Sunday Club Ride (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
Come join some daft Scottish people passionate about Zwift cycling. We ride for an hour every Sunday morning on our weekly social Club ride - often to exercise, sometimes just to sober up.

Group E is a very steady group ride, no way is it a race.  We’re here to encourage beginners and recovering riders to come ride in a group. We’ll be going at between 1.0 and 1.5 watts/kilo, it’s no drop.

The Lead and Sweep banners will riding around these power levels but if you want to go on ahead you are welcome, you might miss the chat and the socialising.  You won’t get removed by riding through the red fence of doom. We might add in some sprints or hill climbs but we will try to re-establish the blob when these are over.  If you fall behind, the sweep or helper will try to drop back to offer a wheel with the intention of trying to help you rejoin the main group or just to keep you company if that’s what you want.

The leader and sweeper will try to keep the group together matching the reasonable

effort at the front and encouraging others to help the sweeper with those at the back.

Please use our “Sunday Club Ride” Discord voice channel here https://discord.com/channels/731107240987197461/1329849787687764079

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

description:
La sorpresa ya tiene nombre: dejamos Watopia y viajamos a Italia para el gran final del Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24,6 km · vuelta y media con final en alto

Un recorrido inspirado en la contrarreloj que abrió el Giro de Italia de 2019, por las calles de Bolonia y con la mítica subida al santuario de San Luca como juez final. Tendrás que pasar dos veces por esas rampas: la primera para medir fuerzas y la segunda para dejarlo todo en la línea de meta, arriba del todo.

Aquí no hay sitio donde esconderse. Dosifica en el llano, guarda piernas para el muro y vacía el depósito en la última subida. La General se decide aquí. 🔥

✅ Recuerda:
• Solo cuentan las carreras de esta etapa listadas en hispevents.com
• Cuenta tu mejor tiempo de la semana: puedes repetir
• Imprescindible potenciómetro real o rodillo inteligente, y pulsómetro
• Para entrar en la General final hay que haber completado las 6 etapas

Clasificación y carreras válidas 👉 hispevents.com
¡Nos vemos en San Luca! 💚❤️


The surprise already has a name: we leave Watopia and travel to Italy for the grand finale of the Tour. 🇮🇹

📍 Bologna TT · 24.6 km · one and a half laps with a summit finish

A route inspired by the time trial that opened the 2019 Giro d'Italia, through the streets of Bologna and with the mythical climb to the Sanctuary of San Luca as the final judge. You'll have to tackle those ramps twice: the first time to gauge your strength and the second to leave everything on the finish line, right at the top.

There's nowhere to hide here. Pace yourself on the flat, save your legs for the wall and empty the tank on the final climb. The General Classification is decided here. 🔥

✅ Remember:
• Only the races of this stage listed on hispevents.com count
• Your best time of the week counts: you can repeat it
• Real power meter or smart trainer, and heart rate monitor essential
• To enter the final General Classification you must have completed all 6 stages

Classification and valid races 👉 hispevents.com

See you at San Luca! 💚❤️

All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>
If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.
RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.
Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

name: ODZentury Sunday Endurance Ride
description:
Come join the world famous ODZentury, the ride that started all the other endurance rides on Zwift.
There will be a 2.5 w/kg group Lead will stay on pace. If you sprint, please regroup. Doing intervals? Please do them off the back and sprint back on. Ride will continue beyond 30 minute event, stay for as little or as much as you want This will be a 2.5 w/kg ride.
There will be a short warmup at the ride lead's discretion (starting at around 2.0w/kg slowly working up to 2.5w/kg), followed by 2.5hrs at a steady 2.5 w/kg.

The ODZentury is designed to hop on easily. For that matter, the event runs just for 30 minutes. At that point, choose ""stay here"" and just keep riding with the group!

Think these events are setup strange? So do we. Vote for Zwift to enable late join for an entire event here https://forums.zwift.com/t/event-late-start-for-duration-of-event/34931

Join us on discord!! https://discordapp.com/invite/0opEuehwdy1ECPBN

#teamodz #ODZ

name: FRR Sunday Drive
description:
"Flamme Rouge Racing Sunday Drive - is this a race ... if you want but equally group up and enjoy the burn.... Different route each week, 90mins to 2hrs

Ride leads may vary each week and when the Tours are on Race Control will certainly be racing... but enjoy them after all it's your time...

If you fancy the hardest but most rewarding Tour on Zwift with great support then come register at 
https://www.flammerougeracing.com/?page=home

Tour of France (21 – 29th October) - Completed
Tour Britannia (25th November - 3 December) - 8 Stages in 9 days
Tour Watopia (2nd – 10th January) - 8 Stages in 9 days
World Tour (17 Feb - 10 March) - 21 Stages 3 weeks full Tour length
World Championship - Apil 12 - 1 Stage 1 time globally

The event Incorporates a mixture of flat, hilly and mountain courses, increasing the intensity as the Tour progresses using a mix of iTT and POINTS races.

EVENT PENs are via autocat and will release at the same time
All riders will see and be able to communicate to each other in race - separatign the most powerful riders is expected to provide more appropriate race starts for every class of rider

Communication

Discord - Tour channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything on the Tour

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Facebook FRR Event Group - A place where we share intentions and thought for community input before we do stuff

So be SMART and use SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anythung more will be removed and warnings will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: The Cortado
description:
Welcome to The Cortado! A Cortado is a delicious coffee drink with equal parts milk and espresso. For our ride this means you get both a relaxed group ride (the milk) and a race at the end (the espresso)!
This ride is fence enabled to keep riders together and the group will move at 2.8-3.5w/kg, keeping the group together until ~10 miles are left in the ride when the espresso race begins.
The Cortado is all about camaraderie, banter, and ripping each others' legs off at the end! Join our Discord server to chat via text or voice if desired!
Give your course suggestions to us at @saris.nopinz on Instagram!

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: THE MERGE - Powered by Formula 369
description:
Welcome to endurance central, it’s time to take your riding to the next level. The Merge powered by Formula 369 is a true endurance long ride. The group is looking to keep steady power pacing and work together to keep pressure on the pedals while we enjoy friendly DIRT chat and social nature. All are welcome, no discrimination, and friendly.

This is NOT a race chase. The D group departs first, then C, and finally B, all riding at advertised pace. This will NATURALLY create a merge/meeting of groups. When groups meet, riders choose to stay with their group and leader or merge with the faster group. Similarly, faster group riders can stay with the slower group. Riders choice.

The group leaders help maintain group cohesion, listen up for their guidance.

A couple other notes:

-30 min late join.

-Sweeps will be organized as needed.

-Climb pace will be announced by the group leader and is designed to keep the group stay together. If you want to work harder, then pull the group on the flats. The group leader and group will NOT chase those doing more than the decided climb pace.

-This ride is designed to keep you in a narrow power band, for true endurance training. This ride is NOT about climbing hard and sitting in on flats and downs.

-Being a nice human is always first priority.

-Those who train together become family. This family works together, supports each other, and cares about each other.

-Those planning to ride an average in the middle of the groups are encouraged to pick a group and stay on pace. Both groups can be pulled on the flats but spreading the group out on climbs or false flats is not appreciated. Those riding 3-3.4 can practice drafting skills with B group.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (NICO OZ)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by NICO OZ (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/00a016b0-d476-475b-a37f-9006766034ed).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

name: CRYO-GEN TSS: The Sunday Session
description:
Kick off your Sunday with a purposeful, two-hour structured burn. The Sunday Session (TSS) is designed for the rider looking to build a massive aerobic engine. We aren’t here to sprint or chase jerseys; we’re here to do the work that makes you an endurance powerhouse on the road.

The Mission
This session focuses on aerobic conditioning. By maintaining a steady and controlled output for 120 minutes or more, we trigger the adaptations necessary to improve our endurance, durability, and fatigue resistance.

The Workout Structure
This is a banded group workout. As long as you keep pedaling, the "rubber band" effect will keep us together regardless of your power output. This event utilizes ERG mode, so your trainer will automatically adjust resistance to hit the target power for each interval. Intervals may feel challenging, even exceeding your estimated functional threshold power (FTP). CRYO-GEN TSS is open to riders of all levels. Embrace the challenge and push yourself to complete the session at the specified power. Your effort will pay off!

Join the Conversation
Use the Zwift Companion App or your keyboard to chat with the group. Share your goals for the upcoming week, discuss your favorite ride snacks, or just enjoy the scenery as we clock hours in the saddle together. See you on the virtual road!

name: DWGZ — Fatica Domenicale
description:
DWGZ — Fatica Domenicale

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Fatica Domenicale — Sunday suffering, Italian-style — is all about the vert. This isn't a steady-state endurance session — it's a hard, hand-picked climbing route we're setting out to conquer together, gradient by gradient. Finish the course and earn your DWGZ jersey — one of two unlock rides on our weekly calendar, alongside Saturday's Hot Hundo, our 100-mile test of grit.

Whether you're chasing the jersey, sharpening your climbing legs, or just want to suffer alongside people who'll cheer you up the last kilometer, this ride is for you.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steep pitches, patient pacing, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, chase the KOM, and climb into the week with us.

name: 6Points Challenges Group Sunday Training Ride
description:
Please look out for our 6Points Challenges group training rides every week, searching #6Points for our rides on the Zwift website or on Zwift Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the yellow beacon ride leader and Red beacon sweeper for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the yellow beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for miniraces. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

Our in-real-life (IRL) Reverence 6Points Mallorca real-life cycling events, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, are ridden around Mallorca and raise money for charities in Mallorca. 6Points has already raised over €300,000 for its chosen charities.

6Points Mallorca is a 3-day ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering a little over 400 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca - hence the name 6Points. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Just as for our Zwift group rides, 6Points Challenges are NOT races. They are opportunities to participate in a challenging ride, in one of several pace groups, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

The 6Points Zwift group ride

As we expect our IRL riders to be able to ride up to 50 miles at or around a 15mph average, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Categories C and D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride, between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the w/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for either:

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our 6Points Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh.

Please see the 6Points Zwift page at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6Points

PS You can check for any of our rides (group rides, TTs and races) that have been scheduled at any time (up to a week ahead) by searching at https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/6points or on Companion.

For those we run for Glasgow Green Cycle Club, GGCC search on https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc or on Companion.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Ride On!!

name: NonSequitur Social Splash
description:
Welcome to the NonSequitur Social Splash! A banded ride for the absolute beginner,
the recovering injured or any Zwifter looking for a relaxing beginner ride that hits the

this ride you ask...bad jokes, typos, riding tips, encouragement but most importantly a

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Wind Down Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp

TOP TIPS
1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!
2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone
3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Ascend Together - A Zwift Climbing Adventure
description:
Join forces with Ascenders and Mountain Massif Club for a weekly tradition: Ascend Together. Each week, we’ll tackle a fresh climbing challenge on Zwift, rotating routes to keep the adventure alive and spirits high. Some weeks, we'll even target special Route Badges — perfect for those climbs that seem a little too daunting when tackled solo.

This ride is open to everyone in the Zwift community because, frankly, we love your company. Expect a steady pace around 2.5 w/kg, designed to keep the group together and the energy strong. Fellow Zwift Clubs are warmly invited to co-lead and/or ride alongside us — after all, this is a celebration of everything we love about Zwift: the rides, the climbs, the camaraderie, the positivity and the community.

No matter your club, team, or solo status, we welcome you to make Ascend Together part of your weekly schedule. Let’s create a ride to remember — every single week. See you on the climb!

description:
Welcome to our Project Sloth group ride.

This ride will be banded to allow people of all abilities to join.

If you have any questions during the ride, please feel free to ask and we will do our best to answer them.

name: The HERD Sunday Endurance
description:
Welcome to the Herd’s Sunday Endurance Ride.

This is not a race, but a long ride at a steady pace with a big group. We ride together for two hours at a pace of 1.5 w/kg on the flats and 2.0 w/kg on climbs.

All riders are welcome and appreciated. Whether you’re brand-new to Zwift or have been on the platform for a decade, we want to ride with you.

Routes change weekly and we ask that you please follow the ride leader’s instructions. The ride leader can turn on the fence if needed to control the pace, but we are always better working as a team. Please respect the leader's pace and stay with the yellow beacon.

Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back, rather than flying off the front. And if you fall off the pace give a shout and someone will fall back to help bring you back to the group.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (CYE Racing)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by CYE Racing (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/f578b4a4-d528-4910-bd6a-b5d236515be4).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.


#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #cyeracing

name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin!
The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a friendly, supportive group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We aim to create a casual, respectful atmosphere that welcomes everyone—from seasoned Zwifters to first‑time group ride participants.
Pace & Expectations
Our overall average pace is typically 18–20 MPH (28–32 KPH). Terrain will naturally influence speed:
- Flats may run slightly faster within the peloton
- Climbs will remain sub‑2 W/kg
- Routes are usually flat, and we strive to be a no‑drop ride
This pace is recovery for some and a solid effort for others, so riders should be prepared to meet the average and stay with the leader’s peloton to enjoy the draft. This is a social ride, not a race—we don’t chase flyers, and flyers are free to fly.
Sweep Support
Sweepers are on hand to help anyone who drifts off the back. Their goal is to ensure no one rides alone unless they prefer to. They may help riders bridge back to the peloton or form a second pace group for a more comfortable experience.
Join the Fun
Come along for the RO4H Sunday Social Spin—you’ll likely break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and definitely have some fun. Welcome to the RO4H family!

eventSubgroups.name: RO4H Sunday Social Spin (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the RO4H Sunday Social Spin. 

The RO4H Sunday Social Spin is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.   

The pace varies depending on terrain but will have an overall average pace of about 18-20 MPH/28-32 KPH for the ride. The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and will remain sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride flat routes and try to be a no-drop ride but ultimately this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leaders peloton to benefit from the group draft effect.  Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — flyers are free to fly — and this ride is certainly not a race (#zwiftisalwaysarace). 

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the peloton or form a second pace group so riders do not ride alone.  

So come along for the RO4H Social Spin — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

name: BMTR Longish Adventure
description:
Join us for a fun and supportive group ride! Everyone is welcome, whether you ride with us for a short time or the whole way.

Our friendly, experienced, and dedicated Ride Leaders make our group rides memorable. They guide the group, keep things fun, encourage conversation and laughter, and help everyone feel included. 

This longer endurance ride lasts about 2.5 to 2.75 hours. The average watts-per-kilogram (w/kg) pace is set so that most C-category riders remain in Zone 2 Endurance or Zone 3 Tempo, assuming Zwift assigns them to the "C" category based on their Functional Threshold Power (FTP).

name: WOW - High Speed Ride on TT bikes with draft
description:
The WOW Zwift events are the fastest way to collect happy miles while meeting exceptional riders/ friends on ZWIFT. While you will be assigned a fast TT bike with a fast wheel set in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Our Es (Emerging Riders) will leave the pen first with a rough power range of 1.3-1.7 W/kg – the group will travel around 32-34km/h. Ds (Development of ‘Drecovery’ 😊) will follow them next and hold the group together within D power limits (1.6-2.0 W/kg) – expected speed is 35-37km/h. Several minutes later C’s (Crusaders) will start and keep riding as one unit guided by the power range of 2.1-2.6 W/kg that will deliver speed between 39 and 41km/h… Further several minutes later the B train (Bombers) starts unleashing their watts within the range of 2.7-3.3 W/kg creating a 42-44km/h draft zone. Several minutes later the A magician group (Aliens) take off and rapidly make up the delays from the groups starting ahead through their 3.4-4.5 power range generating a group speed of 45-48 km/h. When will the groups catch each other? Every catch will be an opportunity to celebrate the ONE WOW FAMILY!

All groups will see each other, transfers between the groups on the go will be possible. The ride leaders will help make those transitions smooth.

WOW is a no drama, full fun ride!

Double draft is on and the fast TT bikes will be drafting!

name: The Zwifty Fifty with DZR
description:
**The Zwifty Fifty: When 25 is Too Little and 100 is Too Much**

DZR brings to you the Goldilocks of Zwift racing intensity and endurance balance. With weekly races at about 50 km, the races are not too short and intensive to build stamina, and not too long and time-consuming to actually get done. They are just right. And they are on every Sunday at 14:45 CET | 8:45 AM EST.

To add to the fun and keep a high intensity throughout the race, we have included bonus second sprints. These sprints are on flats when the finish is on a KOM and on KOMs when the finish is flat.

No powerups, no zpower, no TT bikes, HRM enforced.

For all the details, including stage information, bonus sprints, rules, and registration links, visit the official website for The Zwifty Fifty at http://dzrracingseries.com/the-zwifty-fifty/

name: Level Racing Chase Race
description:
Chase race with riders starting in 4 pens based on CE categories A, B, C, D.  Handicap times are applied between pens.  D cat riders leave first, followed by C, then B and finally A.  The object for each group is to work together to chase and catch the groups ahead of you.  The D cat group will try to stay in front of the other groups.  If the handicaps are correct, then all teams will come together somewhere in the final kilometer,  As this happens, the race changes from working in groups to an individual race, where the first across the line is the winner

To help you chat and work together with others in your pen, Level offer a Discord voice service.  You are welcome to use this if you want.  It’s equally ok to race without it and listen to your music or whatever else you do when racing.  For those who want to use Discord voice, you can join the Level Chase Race Discord server here.  Make sure you join the correct voice channel for your pen!

name: BMTR Short Adventure
description:
The BMTR Short Adventure focuses on enjoying a fun group experience while cycling at an endurance pace.

Our ride leaders are experienced, friendly, and ready to ensure you have a great time. They'll help keep the ride fun and at the right pace for your group!

This event is mainly about "Zone 2 Endurance" riding, which means we’ll be cycling at a comfortable pace. Each category has an average watts per kilogram (w/kg) range designed to keep most riders in their "Zone 2 Endurance" or low "Zone 3 Tempo" zones. Just choose the category that fits your Functional Threshold Power (FTP) or the one that Zwift assigns to you, and you’ll be all set for an enjoyable ride!


**Join Us on Any or All of the Following Platforms!**
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bmtrzwiftclub
Strava: https://www.strava.com/clubs/BMTRZwiftClub
Zwift: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/BMTR/home

name: Phoenix Rising Tronathon (Banded)
description:
Tronathon is a social, supportive banded ride. We help riders build strength, endurance and comfort in riding hills. We also mix in a healthy amount of entertainment and distraction. Tronathon was established in 2020 to help riders earn their Tron bike while also earning the Avid or Masochist badges. This continues to be our goal. All are welcome whether you are a newer cyclist, question if you can reach the summit of one of Zwift's hills, currently hate climbing, or just want to support other riders. Everyone has a story about their first Alpe, Tron quest or the climbing gains they've made and we want to hear yours. We are a fun loving community and welcome all who might want to join us!

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR
Check us out on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/615972979730125/

name: 3R Racing
description:
This RACE is brought to you by 3R to help draw attention to our charity partners. One example is how Buffalo Bikes (provided by the charity WBR for £100/each) can benefit the world's transport needy families.
Expect this RACE to be highly competitive across all CATs. In order to make the racing as fair as possible, racers on zPower, lacking heart rate monitors, riding an an inappropriate category, or riding very unrealistically may be disqualified.
Final results will be available on zwiftpower.com. We hope that everyone gets a great workout and has some good fun in this part of 3R’s #prostyletraining offering. #rideon #RideRaceRaise

description:

name: HPL Cycling Provincial+ Endurance Ride
description:
HPL Cycling is the premiere masters cycling team based out of Saskatchewan, Canada. Check us out at https://www.hplcycling.ca.

Each week we will ride at an endurance pace with focus and control. Riding as a disciplined group, sticking with the yellow beacon is the goal. On occasion your ride leaders may open up the group to sprinting, once the sprint is complete, please regroup on the yellow beacon.   We challenge you to complete the full two hours. If you complete the 2 hours, you will unlock the HPL Cycling kit!

The ride is speed based versus W/kg based. As a result the speeds will increase and decrease with the terrain of the course but effort will remain fairly consistent. The effort required to hold each categories indicated average speed is specific to the individual so choose the category that fits your ability. Each categories overall average speed is indicated in their descriptions.

Once you complete the ride we recommend cooling off with some stretching from Dynamic Cyclist.  Head to https://new.dynamiccyclist.com and use coupon code HPLCYCLING for 25% off of their programming.

#HPLCycling

name: Turbo Classic
description:
"Welcome to the Turbo Classic!

Get ready to test your legs, endurance, and race craft in our weekly Sunday showdown. The Turbo Classic is an endurance-focused race designed to push you into the red and reward smart pacing, teamwork, and grit.

Whether you are building base fitness for outdoor racing or looking for a competitive Sunday long ride, this is your weekly proving ground.

Event Details:
• When: Every Sunday
• Target Duration: 90–120 minutes
• Format: Mass start endurance scratch race (First across the line wins!)
• Categories: A, B, C, D, E

Race Rules & Etiquette:
• Heart Rate Monitor: Required for all riders
• Power Source: Smart trainers or power meters only (no zPower).
• Power-Ups: Enabled—use them wisely on the key climbs and sprint finishes!
• Steering: ON

Course & Strategy:
Expect a challenging mix of sustained flats, punchy rollers, and decisive climbs that will test your heart and lungs. Fuel up beforehand, bring plenty of water and electrolytes, and save some matches for the final kilometers.

See you in the pens! Ride on!

name: ZSUN Sunday Sundae
description:
The Sunday Sundae hits your sweetspot with a big, friendly, supportive and hilly group ride! We cruise the flats in a big blob at steady base pace (circa 2.3-2.5 w/kg); we hit long climbs at sweetspot to threshold interval pace; and we regroup after descents (see below). The climbing pace will be clearly announced before and during each climb and will *usually* be in the 2.8-3.2 w/kg. Course varies from week to week, with total duration normally in the 90-120 minutes range, except for special events.

Please follow the ride leader's instructions and remember that this is not a race. The goal is to ride together, support each other and have fun! Remember also that power figures in this description are those of the beacon and those numbers will vary based on, amongst other factors, rider weight.

REGROUPING
Things will stretch out on the climbs, and that's normal. After the descents, those in front of the beacon will be expected to wait, and there will also be a period of "slow roll" (2.0 w/kg) to allow those not too far behind the beacon to rejoin the peleton for the next flat.

Note that there is currently no sweep for this ride. We aim to stay together, but if you get gapped by the blob, losing the draft effect of the group will make it very difficult to get back and you may be dropped. If/when that happens, you should try to form a gruppetto with others holding a similar pace in order to complete the ride.

name: Herd Classics #5 - Climbers Gambit
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

How does Climbers Gambit work?
Climbers Gambit is our hill climb format, and it’s a little different from a normal race. Only your time on the Innsbruck KOM segment counts. The draft is switched off, so there’s no wheel to hide behind and no group to tow you up. It’s just you, your legs and the climb. The clock that matters starts at the KOM start banner and stops at the KOM banner at the top.

Race rules
Smart trainer or power meter required.
Cadence sensor required.
Heart rate monitor required.
No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence = power).
Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
For elite-level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the performance.
Podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

name: The Mountain Massif
description:
Every great race has a defining climb.

This event is built for riders who thrive when the road tilts skyward. Expect a demanding route featuring sustained ascents, decisive hills, and relentless terrain that rewards patience, tactical awareness, and exceptional endurance.

The strongest rider doesn’t always win—but the smartest one often does.

Conserve your energy in the wheels. Read the race. Cover the moves that matter. Then, when the gradient bites and your rivals begin to fade, commit without hesitation.

The decisive attack will come. The question is whether you’ll be the one launching it—or chasing it.

There are no easy kilometres here. Every climb is an opportunity to gain time. Every descent is a chance to recover. Every decision shapes the final result.

When the summit is in sight, hesitation is the difference between victory and watching the podium ride away.

Race with discipline. Climb with conviction. Finish with nothing left to give.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

name: Team DRAFT Sunday Race
description:
Welcome to the Sunday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!
We encourage that all participants head over to zwiftpower.com and register. For more information see: https://zwiftinsider.com/zwiftpower-signup/ Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration will not be included in the official race results. We also ask that your Zwift activities be saved publicly, and that you open and maintain a Strava account to allow for organizer analysis. Any rider exhibiting questionable performance during a the race may be disqualified.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: Catrina's Ladies Social Ride
description:
I would like to invite ALL women to join this Social Ride & Social exchange! Our goals during the ride are as follows:

1. Recovery from Training
2. Socialization with other women riders (via Catrina’s Social Ride channel or Group Texting in Zwift)
3. Support, Development, & Growth toward becoming better cyclists/athletes in a nurturing group setting
4. Teaching skills in the Zwift program course (Riding in Groups, Draft Effect, Racing Technique, Rolling Cadence, etc.)
5. To have FUN!

This is a Social Ride, with a goal of keeping everyone together, in order to build on group riding skills. This ride is not a "race", although we may practice racing techniques. At all times, we will try to have 1-2 Ladies on the ride to assist the women on the course. Some weeks will be in workout mode but always at z2 efforts. If you yearn for opportunities to meet & socialize with other women cyclists who are passionate about riding, we strongly encourage you to join us!

Ultimately our goal is to enhance your riding experience, while having FUN!

name: Epic Run Crew: Sunday Scoot
description:
This is Epic Run Crew’s weekly long run. We will change the route and distance periodically, to keep the run fresh and fun. Most weeks we will run 15K, but if you don’t want to run that far, come join us for 5 or 10 K. You decide.

Epic Run Crew is based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. We were founded as an in-person club in 2021 and then joined Zwift in June 2022.

name: Turbo Ten p/b HPRT - Race 7 of 10
description:
High Performance Racing Towels are proud to present - Turbo Ten!

On Sunday, take part in ten back to back races on the shortest routes in Zwift!

1 - Downtown Dolphin (2.03km)
2 - The Bel Lap (2.04km)
3 - Macaron (2.6km)
4 - Glasgow Crit Circuit (3.26km)
5 - Glasgow Reverse (4.21km)
6 - LaGuardia Loop (4.3km)
7 - Duchy Estate (4.7km)
8 - LaGuardia Loop Reverse (5.2km)
9 - Queen's Highway (5.6km)
10 - ZG25 Climb Champs (5km)

Riders are categorised into 5 groups using their Compound Score (NB: To calculate your compound score multiply your 90 day best 5 minute power watts by watts oer kilo, eg 200*2=400 if your best 5 minute power is 200w as a 100kg rider)

Category A: 1700 and above
Category B: 1200-1700
Category C: 900-1200
Category D: 600-900
Category E: 0-600

Riders will all start together, but you will be able to see which riders are in your category by the letter on their jersey.

Big Heads and Boost Power ups will be in action! Every rider will receive two boost power ups in the pen (which give you a 1 second boost of power). Use them wisely!

Riders must be using a Smart Trainer, Smart Bike or Power Meter and have a Heart Rate Monitor paired to join the events.

Overall standings are taken from your overall time across all the stages that you take part in, see the results here: https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=3345

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
3R Chase Endurance Ride

Join us for an exhilarating 3R Group Ride Event, where teamwork isn’t just encouraged, it’s essential!

This description does not include the C endurance ride, this is as usual a normal C endurance ride.

In this Chase Endurance Ride, we embark on a 100km journey, following the same course as our Steady State B group. The aim? To gradually close the gap and merge with the Steady State B Group around the 80km mark, setting the stage for an exciting final stretch.

This ride is about group effort and shared responsibility. We expect each rider to contribute, taking turns on the front with pulls of approximately 4.5-5.0 w/kg. Remember, it’s a chase, not a free ride, so we kindly ask that you join in the spirit of collective effort rather than just drafting throughout.

When our group catches up with the Steady State B group, it’s a chance to mix things up! If you’re feeling strong, keep up the pace with the A group. Alternatively, if you’re in the mood for a more relaxed ride, feel free to settle in with the B group.

Remember, this isn’t a race, but a part of our #ProStyleTraining series, designed to support your training goals in a fun, social setting. We love a bit of friendly banter and encourage you to share your experiences and feedback on our Facebook page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/. Let’s ride, raise, race and enjoy together with #Team3R.

name: Zwift Racing: Racing 101
description:
Ready to cross the start line but not sure what to expect? Zwift Racing: Racing 101 helps you build the skills and confidence to take on your first race.

Designed for beginners and curious riders, this guided ride breaks down the fundamentals in a friendly, low-pressure environment. Learn what to expect at the start, how to make the most of the draft, use PowerUps and manage your effort. You’ll also discover four different ways to race, so you can start finding your place in racing.
